question: How can reviewed R1 library QC and X1 annotation summaries be made visible without obscuring source order, technical units or overlapping categories?
decision: Provide two auditable technical QC figures for the existing evidence gallery; no new biological finding or treatment comparison.
strongest_rival: Readers may mistake technical library records for animal replicates or treat overlapping annotation dimensions as disjoint classes.
discriminator: Preserve all six libraries in original order and display explicit units; show symbol multiplicity separately from six overlapping metadata dimensions with their shared denominator.
exposure_record: All source quantities were exposed in original R1/X1 runs, prior independent reviews and current input reading. Layout and source-validation code were tested on synthetic fixtures before freeze. These figures are exposed presentation of reviewed QC, not new unexposed analyses.
biological_unit: R1 unit is a technical library record; separate animal identities remain unknown. X1 unit is a repeated symbol label and its deposited annotation records.
nesting_and_overlap: The same six libraries and same deposited annotation rows are reused from the reviewed source runs. Repeated labels share multiple records; the six annotation ambiguity dimensions overlap. Neither rendering nor repeated-source verification is independent replication.
population_and_selection: All six R1 library rows in source order. All 52 repeated nonempty symbol labels covering 122 rows in X1; all reported multiplicity bins and six prespecified annotation dimensions. No named gene selection or raw expression loading.
contrast: No treatment, condition, variant or biological contrast. Separate technical library records and fixed metadata categories are displayed without inferential comparisons.
endpoint: Copied total counts, nonzero gene rows and largest-ten count fraction per library; copied counts of repeated symbol labels by multiplicity and by multiple stable IDs, chromosomes, strands, coordinate tuples, biotypes and descriptions.
methods: Standard-library CSV/JSON projection and source-receipt hash checks; verify X1 summary cardinalities against repeated_symbols.csv without remapping or new annotation. Matplotlib generates two horizontal-bar figures. R1 uses three aligned panels, unchanged source order, one color, exact integer annotations and largest-ten percentage rounded to four decimals. X1 uses a separate multiplicity partition and overlapping-dimension panel, fixed source dimension order and denominator 52. Exact plot tables and display strings are emitted. Normalize SVG trailing whitespace in memory and parse XML before exclusive first write; never edit frozen results.
missingness_and_exclusions: No rows or zero categories excluded. Reject missing, reordered, duplicated or inconsistent inputs, invalid count denominators, fractions outside zero to one, source-summary disagreements and existing output artifacts. No invented metadata or animal IDs.
multiplicity: No tests, confidence intervals, target ranking or multiple-testing procedure; only the prespecified technical quantities are visualized.
precision_basis: Copied finite technical summaries do not estimate animal-level or population precision. Full source numerical values remain in auditable plot tables.
interpretation_limit: Technical library QC and deposited annotation ambiguity only. No treatment effects, receptor or functional interpretation, animal independence, biological acceptance or reopening of original R2/R3 tasks.
stop_rule: Stop on source/code/hash mismatch, missing or inconsistent fields, source order changes, invalid metadata cardinalities or existing outputs. Preserve failed receipts; do not rewrite frozen sources or relax checks. No raw-source pipeline or held biological task may run.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed render-only QC gallery from already-reviewed immutable R1/X1 tables; no source run superseded or repeated.
